summary.para: The script rescorer does not report any steps.

Every rescorer reports window_size, the number of top documents it was configured to rescore. timed_out is set to true if the search timed out while the rescorer was running. Rescorers can add their own keys.
The time spent in the rescorer, in human-readable units. Only returned when human is true.
The total time spent in the rescorer, including the time spent running its queries.
